title: I/O
explain: The `java.nio.file` classes read and write files with a few calls. `Files.writeString` and `Files.readAllLines` handle small files, and `try`-with-resources is for streams you open yourself. Paths are built with `Path.of`, which works on every operating system.
exercise: Write three names to a file, read them back, and print them in uppercase.
tip: `Files.readAllLines` loads the whole file into memory. For big files use `Files.lines` in a try-with-resources block and process one line at a time.
